# Auto Wasp

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** Auto Wasp

## What it does

Wasps for you. Unable to traverse around blocks, assumes a clear straight line to the target.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/movement/AutoWasp.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
